sn45.13:1.2: Then a certain bhikkhu approached the Blessed One…. Sitting to one side, that bhikkhu said to the Blessed One:
sn45.13:1.3: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘a trainee, a trainee.’
sn45.13:1.4: In what way is one a trainee?”
sn45.13:2.1: “Here, bhikkhu, one possesses a trainee’s right view … a trainee’s right concentration.
sn45.13:2.2: It is in this way that one is a trainee.”
